chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi, may Allah have mercy on him, reported: Ahmad ibn Isa ibn Abu Musa narrated to me in Kufa, from Abdus ibn Muhammad al-Hadhrami, from Muhammad ibn Furat, from Abu Ishaq, from al-Harith, from Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, who said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, used to come to us every morning and say: "Time for prayer! May Allah have mercy on you. Time for prayer!"
"Verily, Allah intends to remove all abomination from you, O People of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification."

key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt: People of the House, the Prophet's family

ai.seo_question: What was the daily practice of the Prophet Muhammad with Ahl al-Bayt regarding the morning prayer?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) narrates the Prophet's daily practice of waking the Ahl al-Bayt for the dawn prayer, combining encouragement with the Verse of Purification (Quran 33:33). This hadith demonstrates the Prophet's personal devotion to his family's spiritual well-being and affirms the special status of the Ahl al-Bayt through the Quranic verse he would recite to them each morning.
